title: Trials and Growth
definition: Trials and growth is the truth that God can use suffering, testing, and hardship to mature faith and deepen dependence on Him.
summary: God uses trials to refine faith, produce endurance, and grow His people.
christFocus: Jesus suffered faithfully and uses trials to form His people in endurance, hope, and Christlike character.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Trials are painful, but they are not pointless. Scripture teaches that God can use testing to produce endurance, maturity, humility, hope, and deeper dependence on Him.

This does not mean believers should pretend suffering is easy or call evil good. Rather, they trust that God is able to work even through hardship for purposes greater than what they can see.

Christ's suffering gives both example and hope. He endured faithfully, and through Him believers receive strength to endure their own trials.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people assume hardship means God is absent or angry. Trials and growth matters because it teaches believers to look for God's refining work without denying the pain of suffering.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask what God may be teaching you in trial. Pray honestly, endure patiently, receive support, and cling to Christ when growth feels slow or painful.
